summary: YC's AI Stack gives students who attend an eligible YC event (starting Fall 2025) over $25,000 in free credits for AI tools and cloud services, including $10,000 each on AWS and Microsoft Azure, $1,000 OpenAI and $500 Anthropic, plus credits from YC-company devtools such as Firecrawl, Exa, Vapi, Browser Use, Reducto and Gumloop. Access lasts one year from the qualifying event.
claim_steps: Attend an eligible YC event (Fall 2025 onward), RSVPing with your Hacker News account
Watch for the confirmation email after the event
Sign in at deals.ycombinator.com/students with the same Hacker News account to check eligibility
Browse and redeem each partner deal
